description: This Java source file defines the ZipSigner class, which provides an API for signing JAR/ZIP files (including APKs) using SHA1 and RSA keys. It includes methods for signing files, managing cryptographic keys, generating signature files, and handling progress and observer notifications. The class is heavily modified from Android's signapk implementation, adding convenience methods, progress listeners, and signature verification features.

classes.name: ZipSigner
classes.description: Main class providing methods for signing ZIP/JAR/APK files, managing cryptographic keys, and handling progress and observer notifications.

classes.name: AutoKeyObservable
classes.description: Observable subclass used for notifying observers about auto-detected key changes.
